data.name: Hidayaatun
data.gender_notes: Hidayaatun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'hidayah' which means 'guidance' or 'direction'. The name is given to a child as a symbol of hope and light in their life, and a reminder of the importance of following the right path. It is also believed to bring blessings and protection to the bearer. The name Hidayaatun carries the meaning “Guide, Direct” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Hidayaatun usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, direct and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the presence of a spiritual guide or guardian in the life of the bearer. It is a reminder to stay on the path of righteousness and to seek guidance from Allah.
data.etymology: Hidayaatun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Direct.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hidayaatun total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
